low.definition: One file or one mechanical change with an obvious solution.
low.example: Fix a typo, rename a local variable, update a constant.

medium.definition: A few files in one component, following a pattern that already exists.
medium.example: Add an option to an existing command, with its test.

high.definition: Several components, a new design choice, or behaviour that is hard to test.
high.example: Add a module with its own state and callers in two components.

critical.definition: A change across shared core, concurrency or stored formats, where a wrong design is costly to undo.
critical.example: Change the ledger's reservation rules or a stored record format.

low.definition: A mistake is caught by existing checks and affects only this task.

medium.definition: A mistake could break one feature and is easy to revert.
medium.example: A change to one command's output or validation.

high.definition: A mistake could lose data, spend money, weaken a safety rule or break many callers.

critical.definition: A mistake could be irreversible or expose a secret.
critical.example: Credential handling, destructive operations, release steps.

roster.label: Orchestrator
roster.when_to_use: Coordinates a task that spans several areas and delegates each part to other specialists.

roster.label: Code Reviewer
roster.when_to_use: Reviews any code change for bugs, error handling and test coverage.

roster.label: Security Reviewer
roster.when_to_use: Reviews a change for common web vulnerabilities, committed secrets, authentication flaws and vulnerable dependencies.

roster.label: TypeScript Reviewer
roster.when_to_use: Reviews TypeScript or JavaScript for type safety, async correctness, injection and prototype pollution.

roster.label: React Reviewer
roster.when_to_use: Reviews React code for hook rules, server and client component boundaries, accessibility and render performance.

roster.label: React Build Resolver
roster.when_to_use: Fixes a broken build or development server: bundler configuration, compile errors, missing types.

roster.label: Test Engineer
roster.when_to_use: Writes unit and integration tests, test first, including edge cases.

roster.label: QA Automation Engineer
roster.when_to_use: Writes end-to-end tests and pipeline quality gates for a critical user flow.

roster.label: Database Architect
roster.when_to_use: Designs schemas, migrations, indexes and query strategy.

roster.label: DevOps Engineer
roster.when_to_use: Works on deployment, pipelines, infrastructure and production operations.

roster.label: Backend Specialist
roster.when_to_use: Builds API endpoints, server-side business logic and data persistence.

roster.label: Frontend Specialist
roster.when_to_use: Builds interface components, layout, styling and frontend structure.

roster.label: SEO Specialist
roster.when_to_use: Works on metadata, structured data, search indexing and visibility in AI search.

roster.label: Performance Optimizer
roster.when_to_use: Removes a bottleneck that profiling has already identified.

roster.label: Software Engineer
roster.when_to_use: Implements a change that no narrower specialist covers.

roster.label: Product Manager
roster.when_to_use: Clarifies undefined or ambiguous requirements before a work item exists.

roster.label: Product Owner
roster.when_to_use: Turns a business goal into acceptance criteria for a work item.

roster.label: Project Planner
roster.when_to_use: Breaks a feature into ordered, executable tasks.

roster.label: Code Archaeologist
roster.when_to_use: Explains legacy or undocumented code before it is changed.

roster.label: Debugger
roster.when_to_use: Finds the root cause of a bug, crash or flaky test before any fix is proposed.

roster.label: Explorer Agent
roster.when_to_use: Maps an unfamiliar or complex codebase before a change is planned.

roster.label: Documentation Writer
roster.when_to_use: Writes or updates READMEs, API documentation and runbooks on request.

roster.label: Penetration Tester
roster.when_to_use: Simulates attacks against a real authentication flow or release.

roster.label: Security Auditor
roster.when_to_use: Reviews defence in depth and models threats before an important release.
